title: Geleceği Bilen Adam — Bölüm 1
outfit: (he comes from 2026, so modern streetwear) mustard-yellow ribbed knit beanie, oversized dark navy bomber jacket with burnt-orange inner lining, charcoal-grey t-shirt, loose black cargo pants, chunky red-and-white high-top sneakers

scenes.prompt: Karakter 90'lar Türk evinde yatakta doğruluyor; duvarda 1999 takvimi, tüplü televizyon, dantel örtü, sabah ışığı ve pencereden pembe neon
scenes.prompt_en: the character sitting up in bed, startled, in a 1990s Turkish bedroom: a 1999 wall calendar, a bulky CRT television on a lace doily, patterned wallpaper, early-morning light mixed with pink neon from the window

scenes.prompt: Karakterin elinde parlayan modern akıllı telefon, arkada kablolu ev telefonu ve tüplü TV
scenes.prompt_en: close-up of the character holding a glowing modern smartphone, its light on his face, a corded rotary-style home phone and a CRT TV behind him

scenes.prompt: 1999 İstanbul gece sokağı, eski Şahin otomobil, ankesörlü telefon kulübesi, karakter arkası dönük yürüyor
scenes.prompt_en: a wide shot of a rainy 1999 Istanbul street at night, the character small in the lower third, seen completely FROM BEHIND walking away from the camera (we see his back and the back of his beanie, not his face), an old boxy 1990s sedan parked by the curb, a payphone booth, shop signs are only abstract glowing pink shapes with absolutely no letters or words, wet asphalt reflections, the upper half of the image is dark empty night sky

scenes.prompt: Karakter açık cüzdanına bakıyor, şaşkın ve terli
scenes.prompt_en: the character staring into his open wallet in shock, a sweat drop on his head, standing in a narrow 1990s apartment hallway

scenes.prompt: Bakkal tezgâhı, karakter modern banknot uzatıyor, bıyıklı bakkal şüpheyle bakıyor
scenes.prompt_en: a 1990s Turkish corner shop counter with glass jars of candy and cigarette racks, the character holding out a modern banknote, a mustached shopkeeper squinting at it suspiciously

scenes.prompt: Telefon ekranında kırmızı düşük pil uyarısı, karakter eski bir prize bakıyor
scenes.prompt_en: the character looking desperately at an old round wall socket, his smartphone showing a red low-battery icon in his hand

scenes.prompt: Karakter dramatik ışıkta, kararlı yüz ifadesi
scenes.prompt_en: the character in dramatic side lighting, determined expression, looking straight at the viewer

scenes.prompt: Karakter kahvehanede ayağa kalkmış, elinde telefon, herkes ona bakıyor
scenes.prompt_en: the character standing up in the coffeehouse raising his smartphone, everyone turning to stare at him in disbelief

scenes.prompt: Karakter yağmurlu gece penceresinden dışarı bakıyor, sırrını saklıyor
scenes.prompt_en: the character alone at a rainy night window, finger on his lips, keeping a secret, pink neon reflections on the glass

scenes.prompt: Karakter yakın plan, eli kameraya doğru, endişeli yüz, neon arka plan
scenes.prompt_en: close-up of the character holding his open hand toward the camera, worried face, blurred pink neon background

scenes.body:
Yorumlara **ANLAT** ya da **SUS** yaz.
Çoğunluk 2. bölümü yazar.
